title: Gap Duration Bar Chart Visualization
description: Create GapBarChart.kt extending existing BarChart patterns. X-axis shows chronological streaks/gaps, Y-axis shows duration in days. Displays stint durations as vertical bars with configurable-period SMA trend line overlay, color-coded by state type, and interactive tap-to-detail functionality. Direction-aware for positive vs negative habit tracking.
